result_summary.title: Subscription Manager overcharging users and ignoring refunds (APAC)
result_summary.description: Our Subscription Manager in the APAC production region is overcharging customers and not reflecting recent refunds. This high-impact issue affects 559 users. We have verified that refund transactions were processed upstream, but the Subscription Manager continues to bill the full amount. This is causing significant financial and support overhead. Please assist in correcting the billing state.

result_summary.note: Call again with one of these metric_category values to see actual readings.

health_events.description: Automated health check flagged Fee Calculation Engine as degraded (minor) for 15 minutes.
Brief major health blip on Fee Calculation Engine: elevated error rate for 10 minutes.
Transient minor availability dip on Fee Calculation Engine, recovered within 20 minutes.
minor latency spike observed on Fee Calculation Engine, self-resolved after 5 minutes.

final_diagnosis.recommended_next_action: Verify the configuration of the Subscription Manager and the Fee Calculation Engine to ensure they are correctly integrated and functioning as expected.
final_diagnosis.evidence_summary: The Subscription Manager is overcharging users and ignoring refunds due to a potential misconfiguration. The Fee Calculation Engine has experienced minor health events and transient availability dips, which may be related to the issue. Further investigation is needed to determine the root cause and prevent similar issues in the future.
unresolved_uncertainties: The exact cause of the misconfiguration and how to prevent it in the future.
